title: charter conflict: does a `Clause-②: no` PR that touches no contract surface still owe an in-seat review before it can land?
body:
**Two rules in the seat's own charter give different answers for the same PR, and the seat cannot resolve the text on the spot.** Filed under 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」. The seat is acting on the stricter reading meanwhile, and says so on the affected cards.

## The situation that forced the question

Two PRs from this lane are `Clause-②: no`, CI-green or nearly so, and touch **no** contract surface:

- **#18530** (card #18010) — one file, `packages/spec/scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-cleanup.test.ts`
- **#18529** (card #18301) — `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts` + its check-mode test

Meanwhile the contract-review tier is refusing at the account level (HTTP 429), so no isolated at-tier review can run at all. Whether these two may land turns entirely on which rule governs.

## Reading A — the enqueue gate says no review is owed

`SKILL.md` 〈入队与落地〉:

> `--tier` 嫌疑行是提示非裁定;双肢命中任一 ⇒ 无席内条款②复核 PASS 在案 ⛔ 禁止入队。
> 路径肢 = diff 触及契约面 `packages/spec/src/**`,含 error-code-ledger 与 `*.zod.ts` 契约 schema。
> 声明肢 = 认领评论声明 `Clause-②: yes`,与路径无关。

Neither limb hits: the diffs are `packages/spec/scripts/**`, which is **not** `packages/spec/src/**`, and both claims declare `no`. The rule is stated as a prohibition conditioned on a limb hitting ⇒ with no limb hit, no in-seat clause-② review PASS is required, and the two-limb machinery exists precisely to decide when one is owed. `check-clause2-carriers --pair` agrees in its own output: exit 0, "no widening tell", and — unlike the `yes` PRs — it prints **no** C6-RECORD row demanding a review of record on the head.

## Reading B — post-delivery review is owed for every delivered round, at-tier for this lane

`references/contract-review.md` and the same SKILL section:

> 逐车道:spec 席达档审契约增量;余席默认档自审加门禁、挂标;豁免仅独立性件与保险丝。
> 交付后复核由派发席席内完成:spec 席达档,余席默认档加门禁;记录 = 同形评论落 PR 或卡。
> 独立性件:契约真分叉、dev 挂旗或派发后的跨车道面(含 spec)⇒ 起隔离的达档复核子代理。

「交付后复核由派发席席内完成」 is unconditional on its face. And **both** rounds raised flags — #18010's dev put an A/B/C `open_questions` in front of the seat, #18301's round is answering a CI red — so 「dev 挂旗」 is satisfied, which makes them **independence cases**, and the only exemptions named are independence cases and the fuse. Under this reading an isolated at-tier review is required even though the clause-② gate never fires.

## Why the seat cannot just pick

Reading A is supported by the gate's structure (two limbs whose whole job is to decide when a review is owed, and a checker that demands a review record only for `yes`). Reading B is supported by the plain text of two sentences that are not conditioned on a limb. ⛔ Neither is obviously the drafter's intent, and the seat is not entitled to settle it by choosing the answer that unblocks its own queue — which is exactly what Reading A would do today.

## What the seat is doing meanwhile

**Acting on Reading B (the stricter one).** #18530 and #18529 stay draft, out of the queue, until either the tier returns or this card is answered. A PR that waits loses time; a PR landed without a review the rules wanted cannot be un-landed.

⚠️ The cost is worth stating plainly: with the tier refusing, Reading B means **nothing from this lane can land at all** — not the contract work, and not the test/script work either.

## What an answer looks like

Either (a) confirm Reading A and say so in the charter — a non-limb PR is collected with a default-tier seat record and lands on the three pre-checks; or (b) confirm Reading B and make 「交付后复核」 explicitly unconditional, in which case the `Clause-②` limbs decide the TIER of the review rather than its existence; or (c) a third shape: a flag raised by a dev pulls a non-limb PR into at-tier review, which is what the independence sentence would mean if read narrowly.

⚠️ Whichever it is, the sentence 「豁免仅独立性件与保险丝」 needs to say what it exempts them FROM, because today it can be read as exempting them from the default tier (i.e. forcing at-tier) or as exempting them from review entirely.

Dedupe words: `双肢命中任一`, `交付后复核由派发席席内完成`, `独立性件 dev 挂旗`, `Clause-② no 非限定 PR 落地`, `packages/spec/scripts 不是契约面`.
